actual_scope: Sharp pointwise tensor threshold T(4)=13 for the full Gaussian-dyadic four-qubit Clifford group, exact width-eleven support and width-twelve inflated-block lower bound; supporting Dickson obstruction for positive n divisible by four.
scope_change_reason: The released width-ten question led to a missing Dickson block. The same source projection settles width eleven, the Pauli-invariant width-twelve obstruction and width-thirteen completeness, so all are included as one result.

stop_rule: Stop after the sharp four-qubit threshold and its exact multiplicities are proved and checked; leave full even-sector ranks, other qubit congruences and physical costs explicit.
evidence: PROOF.md proves T(4)=13. RESULT.json gives all 81 multiplicities at widths eleven and thirteen, exact norm and dimension checks, and finite Dickson/Pauli/Clifford evidence. The original table projection was rederived from the authenticated archive.
